ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Amagi Media Labs Limited has significantly expanded its partnership with TV9 Network, now managing end-to-end CTV/Digital operations, distribution, and monetization for the major Indian news network. This collaboration marks TV9 as the first Indian broadcaster to implement Amagi's AdFlow Orchestrator, reportedly leading to improvements in viewership retention, time spent, and monetization opportunities. This development strengthens Amagi's market position in India's rapidly evolving cloud-native and CTV monetization landscape, with no apparent red flags in this positive growth announcement.
